brewery.ponder.kettle.text_1: The kettle needs heat beneath it. The exact heat of the recipe keeps full quality
brewery.ponder.kettle.text_2: Fill it with water, by bucket or by pipe
brewery.ponder.kettle.text_3: The kettle brews everything inside it. Add more and the brew starts over
brewery.ponder.kettle.text_4: After a while the water has become wort, ready for the next machine
brewery.ponder.kettle.text_5: A spout on the kettle bottles the wort straight away
brewery.ponder.distillery.text_1: The distillery turns wort into distillate. It also needs heat beneath it
brewery.ponder.distillery.text_2: Pipe in wort from a kettle. A kettle right next to it also works, with the Load button
brewery.ponder.distillery.text_3: Drive the shaft in its back. Each drink has its own speed: find it by the stars
brewery.ponder.distillery.text_4: Close to the ideal speed keeps the stars. Half of it costs most of them, and double spoils the batch
brewery.ponder.distillery.text_5: The distillate goes to a barrel, and some can be bottled at once with a spout or from your hand
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_1: The barrel takes distillate, or a bottle of a young drink
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_2: Wood goes in too and is not used up. Each drink ages best in its own wood
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_3: Barrels side by side, facing the same way, work as one. Each one adds room for more
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_4: Press Start and wait the drink's days. Sleeping counts, so a bed speeds it up
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_5: Fed by a funnel, it starts on its own and keeps going
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_6: A spout bottles the drink, from your hand or from empty bottles fed in by funnel
brewery.ponder.barrel.text_7: Collect it on time: a finished drink left in the barrel slowly loses its stars
gui.brewery.barrel_slot_locked: Place another barrel beside this one
